source: Copy of Omnicom Global Model - June 2026 Preview.xlsx

units.share: Fraction of that market’s total media spend (0–1)

caveats: Model is market-level advertising spend (NAR = Net Advertising Revenue). No client/brand/campaign/creative data.
Annual only (1999–2030). 2026+ are forecasts; 2025 is a current-year estimate.
FX is constant (flat across years) for comparability, not historical annual rates.
local = each market’s own currency (millions) and is NOT cross-market comparable; use constant_usd for comparisons.
Local tabs cover 24 core markets; constant_usd/share/growth also include regional & grouping aggregates (APAC/EMEA/LatAm/NA, Europe, BRIC, G14, etc.).
macro tab values (CPI/Real GDP/Nominal GDP) appear to be year-on-year growth fractions, not absolute levels — verify before headline use.
Population and GDP-per-capita exist in the BENCHMARK tabs (2025 snapshot) but were NOT extracted this pass (lookup-indexed layout).
Per-country detail worksheets (18) and Streaming/Cross-Platform tabs were not unpacked into facts this pass; the per-channel tabs already provide the full market×channel×year cube.
